summary: Join our Real Estate Investment Training Course to master the basics of property investment. Equip yourself with the tools needed for a profitable future.
lede: Real estate investment training gives property decision-makers a structured way to assess potential purchases. It is suited to professionals approving property budgets, evaluating assets, or beginning to invest, and develops practical skills in comparing property types and markets, estimating costs, rental income and returns, and assessing financing and investment risks. Participants also learn to check a deal and present a reasoned recommendation to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals across various sectors who are involved in property decision-making or wish to start investing with clarity and precision.
modules: Understanding Property Markets and Location Logic
Cost Mapping and Total Investment Cost
Cash Flow and Rental Income Analysis
Due Diligence and Risk Red Flags
Building and Presenting the Investment Case
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial concepts and investment principles. No prior real estate experience is required, but a keen interest in property investment is recommended.
